meta.title: Sigma Brain - Sigma CX
meta.description: The intelligence behind digital interactions: an autonomous AI agent in voice and text.

intro.title: **Sigma Brain** is the intelligence behind digital interactions
intro.body: It works in both voice and text, an autonomous AI agent capable of understanding intentions, analyzing sentiment, and acting throughout the journey to resolve customer requests.
intro.cta: What is the difference between Chatbots and AI Agents?

items.eyebrow: Natural and empathetic dialogues that resolve issues the first time
items.title: Deliver fluid and effective conversations 24/7
items.body: With generative AI and natural language recognition, Sigma Brain understands natural language contextually, increasing first-touch resolution and emotional engagement.

items.title: Speak your customer's language, anywhere
items.body: Translate calls in real time and adapt your communication style to their cultural profile. Additionally, personalize the experience with customizable accents, making the interaction more intimate and natural for each audience.

items.title: Empathetic service in every call
items.body: Identify the customer's tone of voice and emotional state in real time, and adjust your responses to convey empathy. With integrated sentiment analysis and language adaptation, create more human conversations, strengthening trust and increasing satisfaction.

tabs.label: Be present on all channels
tabs.body: Connect via voice, chat, social media, and messaging apps in a seamless experience, without customers having to repeat information.

tabs.label: Gain efficiency at scale
tabs.body: Automate codeless workflows and reduce manual tasks, freeing your team for strategic, higher-value interactions.

tabs.label: Deliver more human experiences
tabs.body: Use generative AI to understand intent, analyze sentiment, and deliver contextual responses that increase customer satisfaction.

items.title: Build bots in minutes
items.body: Build intelligent assistants without coding and dramatically reduce time to market.

items.title: Scale channels with one click
items.body: Quickly expand to WhatsApp, voice, social media, and more, without technical complexity.

journeys.title: Build flexible journeys
journeys.body: Offer interactive menus, direct customers to different actions, and simplify every step of the service process.

nocode.title: Create, adjust, and scale customer journeys without coding
nocode.body: No-code puts the power of innovation in the hands of your team. Flows, campaigns, and analytics can be configured visually and intuitively, reducing reliance on technical teams and accelerating response time to business demands.

items.title: Intelligent automation
items.body: Eliminates repetitive tasks, reducing costs and average service time.

items.title: Unified context
items.body: Maintains customer history across all channels, ensuring consistency and personalization.

items.title: End-to-end resolution
items.body: Not only responds but acts, executes and completes processes, like a digital collaborator.

items.title: Continuous learning
items.body: Improves with every interaction, identifying patterns and anticipating needs.
